name: Occultist Scholar Archetype
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (dungeoneering) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Spirit Binder I (Ex)

You may seal pacts with otherworldly entities known as spirits. In order to summon a spirit, you must learn the spirit’s ceremony, constellation, personality, and seal by completing its four Knowledge Tasks; see “Researching the Spirit” (Pact Magic Unbound: Grimoire of Lost Souls, page 86) for more information on this process. When you gain this study ability, you are automatically assumed to have completed all four Knowledge Tasks for one 1st-level spirit of your choice. Each day, you may bind one spirit to your soul using pact magic; see “Performing a Pact Ritual” (Pact Magic Unbound: Grimoire of Lost Souls, chapter 3). You must choose one constellation. You may only seal pacts with starless spirits and spirits belonging to your chosen constellation. All other constellations are barred to you. The spirit’s level may not exceed your maximum spirit level, which is initially limited to 1st-level spirits. When you reach 7 ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering), your maximum spirit level increases by 1. You have an effective binder level equal to 1/2 your ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering). The DC to resist one of your supernatural powers is equal to 10 + 1/2 your effective binder level + your Charisma modifier.

Associated Technique
Siphoning Technique (Ex)

If you kill a target you have studied with this ability, you gain 1d4 temporary hit points. This amount increases by a further 1d4 hit points at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5d4 hit points at 20th level.

This technique has no effect unless the target studied is a significant opponent with at least half as many Hit Dice as you. These temporary hit points last for a maximum of 1 hour. If you kill another significant opponent, additional temporary hit points do not stack but may reset the amount and duration.

Advanced Study Abilities
Binder Secret (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Spirit Binder I study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain a binder secret, using your ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering) as your effective pactmaker level for the purpose of meeting any prerequisites.

Special: You can select this study ability up to two times. Each time, you gain a different binder secret.

Spirit Binder II (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Spirit Binder I study ability, scholar level 3rd.

Your effective binder level is now equal to your total ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering). When you reach 4 and 13 ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering), your maximum spirit level increases by 1.

Spirit Binder III (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Spirit Binder II study ability, scholar level 10th.

Your spirit level increases by 1. When you reach 16 ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering), your maximum spirit level increases by 1 again (to a maximum of 6th-level). In addition, you are no longer limited to starless spirits and spirits from your chosen constellation.

The Scholar. © 2024, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
